profile.summary: Smith College is a private women's college in Northampton, Massachusetts, founded in 1871. It offers an open curriculum with courses in many fields of study and enrolls students from across the United States and other countries. It is a member of the Five College Consortium in western Massachusetts.

sources.title: Trustees Of The Smith College - Nonprofit Explorer - ProPublica

review.notes: The agenda names Smith College in Northampton, MA, and ProPublica lists Trustees of the Smith College (EIN 04-1843040, 501(c)(3)) in Northampton. The smith.edu page confirms the address, phone, 1871 founding, open curriculum and Five College membership. The page does not use the phrase 'private women's college' verbatim, but that is common knowledge about this institution. No source names OUSD directly, though a college MOU with Talent/HR is plausible.
